# ElevenLabs — Style Reference

> warm plaster studio, ink-black pills, and one glowing ember orb. Waldenburg Light headlines over Inter on a #fdfcfc canvas, edges drawn with half-pixel rings, and every saturated hue sealed inside spherical voice artwork.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

ElevenLabs runs a warm-plaster audio-studio language. The base is a #fdfcfc canvas. #f5f3f1 linen trays (33 uses) hold content, and #ffffff cards (40 uses) lift the selected item out of those trays. The interface chrome spends zero saturated hues. Black #000000 carries text (167 uses) and fills the primary pill. The only chromatic tokens are two product-identity dots, #ff4704 and #0447ff, at 2 uses each; all other color lives inside gradient voice orbs and product screenshots. Typography inverts the usual display convention. Waldenburg at weight 300 sets 36px and 48px headlines, with -0.96px tracking at the top size. Inter 400 and 500 runs every label from 13 to 16px with +0.01em tracking. Hierarchy therefore comes from size and grayscale tone (#000000, then #777169, then #a59f97), and weight does almost none of the work. Shapes split into 9999px pills and 16px cards. Elevation is a 0.5px ring plus a 4% drop. The result reads as a quiet recording room rather than a loud AI launch page.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paper Canvas | `#fdfcfc` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Body background behind the hero, logo wall and section text — a warm off-white that makes the #ffffff cards register as lifted without any shadow. |
| Frosted Card | `#ffffff` | `--color-frosted-card` | Secondary pills, the active product tab, the text-to-speech panel and feature-tile icon squares, at 40 uses — the "selected" surface that rises out of linen trays. |
| Linen Panel | `#f5f3f1` | `--color-linen-panel` | Showcase card, tab rail, feature tiles and screenshot frames, at 33 uses — the warm tray that groups content and replaces most borders. |
| Onyx Scrim | `#0000004d` | `--color-onyx-scrim` | Translucent overlay on imagery and media controls, at 18 uses — the glass layer. Do not use it as a flat gray fill on the canvas. |
| Ink | `#000000` | `--color-ink` | Headlines, body copy, nav labels and active carousel captions, at 167 uses — pure black, because the warmth lives in the surfaces, not the text. |
| Graphite Body | `#44403b` | `--color-graphite-body` | Secondary running copy and inactive chip labels, at 8 uses — a warm near-black that softens long passages without losing contrast. |
| Pebble Caption | `#777169` | `--color-pebble-caption` | Eyebrow labels, inactive carousel titles and feature-tile kickers, at 55 uses — the workhorse secondary tone, warm-tinted to match the linen. |
| Ash Whisper | `#a59f97` | `--color-ash-whisper` | Carousel descriptions, bracketed audio tags such as [whispers] and tertiary metadata, at 8 uses — the quietest legible tone. Do not set body paragraphs in it. |
| Sand Hairline | `#ebe8e4` | `--color-sand-hairline` | Logo-wall grid lines, section rails and divider fills, at 3 uses — a warm 1px rule that stays visible on both #fdfcfc and #f5f3f1. |
| Carbon Hairline | `#00000013` | `--color-carbon-hairline` | Translucent 1px borders on controls laid over mixed backgrounds — it tints with whatever sits behind it, unlike the opaque Sand rule. |
| Jet Action | `#000000` | `--color-jet-action` | Filled pills for Sign up, Learn more and Play — the primary action fill, aliased to Ink so the CTA is the darkest object rather than the most colorful one. |
| Ember Dot | `#ff4704` | `--color-ember-dot` | ElevenCreative product dot and matching orb glyphs, at 2 uses — decorative-only identity punctuation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color. |
| Cobalt Dot | `#0447ff` | `--color-cobalt-dot` | Second product-identity dot and small decorative glyphs, at 2 uses — the only other chromatic token. Keep it under 12px in diameter. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Waldenburg — light-weight display face for section and hero headlines · `--font-waldenburg`

- **Substitute:** General Sans at 300, Switzer at 300, Geist at 300. Waldenburg Light draws slightly heavier than its nominal 300 and has open apertures. Inter at 300 renders visibly thinner at 48px, so do not use it as a stand-in.
- **Weights:** 300
- **Sizes:** 32px, 36px, 48px
- **Line height:** 1.083 to 1.167
- **Letter spacing:** -0.96px at 48px; normal at 36px and 32px
- **Role:** Weight 300 at display sizes is the signature: headlines are large and quiet, and most AI landing pages do the opposite with 600 to 700. The 36px to 48px step is exactly 1.333, a Perfect Fourth, so the display tier follows convention even though its weight does not. Only the 48px hero gets negative tracking (-0.02em). The 36px section heads keep normal spacing, which leaves them airy rather than compressed.

### Inter — UI and body workhorse for every label, button and paragraph · `--font-inter`

- **Substitute:** Inter at 400 and 500 (the original is free), Geist at 400 and 500, Public Sans at 400 and 500. All three match stroke weight at 14 to 16px.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 10px, 12px, 13px, 14px, 15px, 16px, 18px, 20px
- **Line height:** 1.333 to 1.5
- **Letter spacing:** 0.14px at 14px, 0.15px at 15px, 0.16px at 16px, 0.18px at 18px; normal at 12px, 13px and 20px
- **Role:** Inter carries 246 of the 285 measured weight usages. Its 500 (103 uses) is reserved for compact UI labels at 14px rather than for headlines. The body steps run 14, 15 and 16px, a ratio near 1.07 per step and far tighter than a Minor Third. Text size therefore barely varies, and tone does the ranking. The constant +0.01em tracking loosens small text toward a printed-caption feel.

### Geist Mono — detected in extracted data but not described · `--font-geist-mono`

- **Substitute:** Geist Mono at 400 (free), JetBrains Mono at 400, IBM Plex Mono at 400
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 13px
- **Line height:** 1.692
- **Letter spacing:** normal at 13px
- **Role:** detected in extracted data but not described

### Type Scale

| small | Inter | 500 | 12px | 1.333 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Inter | 400 | 13px | 1.385 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Inter | — | 14px | 1.5 | 0.14px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Inter | 400 | 15px | 1.467 | 0.15px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Inter | 400 | 16px | 1.5 | 0.16px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Inter | 400 | 18px | 1.444 | 0.18px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Inter | 400 | 20px | 1.35 | 0px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Waldenburg | 300 | 32px | 1.125 | 0px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | Waldenburg | 300 | 36px | 1.167 | 0px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Waldenburg | 300 | 48px | 1.083 | -0.96px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every section headline in Waldenburg at weight 300, 36px, with 1.167 line-height — the light display weight is the brand's voice, and the restraint is non-negotiable.
- Pair every #000000 Ink pill with a #ffffff Paper pill carrying shadow sm — the two-pill couplet is the system's only action grammar.
- Group content on #f5f3f1 trays with a 16px radius before reaching for borders — tonal layering keeps line count low.
- Rank text by tone: #000000 for primary, #777169 for labels, #a59f97 for tertiary — size steps of 14, 15 and 16px are too close to carry hierarchy alone.
- Keep Inter tracking at +0.01em (0.14px at 14px, 0.16px at 16px) — the looseness gives small UI text its printed calm.
- Separate sections with 160px of #fdfcfc — the generous gap is what makes a light-weight headline feel confident.
- Confine saturated color to orbs, screenshots and 8px product dots in #ff4704 or #0447ff — color is content here, not chrome.

### Don't

- Don't bump headlines to weight 500 or 600 to "add punch" — at 48px a heavier Waldenburg turns the whisper into a shout and breaks the quiet-authority thesis.
- Don't fill the primary CTA with #ff4704 — an orange button competes with the orbs and makes the brand look like every other AI tool.
- Don't replace the 0.5px ring with a 1px solid #e5e5e5 border on buttons — the doubled edge reads as a form field, not a pill.
- Don't use cool grays such as #6b7280 for secondary text — they clash with #f5f3f1 and drain the warm plaster feel; stay on #777169.
- Don't add drop shadows above 4% opacity or beyond 4px blur — the system lifts with tone and half-pixel rings, and heavy shadows float cards off the page.
- Don't round cards to 24px or square them to 4px — 16px cards against 9999px pills is the whole shape vocabulary, and a third value muddies it.
- Never apply a gradient to an interface surface such as a tray, nav or button — gradients belong to the orb artwork, and on chrome they erase the line between content and frame.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #fdfcfc (Paper Canvas)
- tray surface: #f5f3f1 (Linen Panel)
- lifted card: #ffffff (Frosted Card)
- primary text: #000000 (Ink)
- secondary text: #777169 (Pebble Caption)
- hairline: #ebe8e4 (Sand Hairline)
- primary action: #000000 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and graphs use #000000 lines and #777169 axes on #ffffff, with series fills as #0447ff tints at 10% opacity at most and #ff4704 limited to a single 8px marker. No data element may be more saturated or larger than an orb.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button. Make an anchor with background #000000, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 9999px, padding 0 20px and height 44px. Set it in Inter at 16px, weight 400 and line-height 1.5, with no shadow. On hover, drop the background opacity to 85%. Place it beside a secondary button with background #ffffff, text #000000, the same 9999px radius, 0 20px padding and 44px height, with box-shadow `0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.125), 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)` and an 8px gap between the two.

2. Build a hero section. Use a #fdfcfc page background and a 1180px max-width container with a two-column grid. In the left column, put an h1 in Waldenburg (fallback General Sans) at weight 300, 48px, line-height 1.083, letter-spacing -0.96px and color #000000, with two lines maximum. Follow it, 32px below, with the Ink and Paper pill couplet at 44px. In the right column, top-aligned, put a paragraph in Inter 400 at 16px, line-height 1.5, letter-spacing 0.16px and color #000000. Below, 48px down, add a full-width card with background #f5f3f1, radius 16px, padding 0 32px and box-shadow `inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.075)`.

3. Build a feature tile in a 4-column grid with a 12px gap. Give each tile background #f5f3f1, radius 16px, padding 20px, a 160px minimum height and box-shadow `inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.075)`. Top-left, place a 32px #ffffff square with radius 8px, box-shadow `inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)` and a 16px monoline #000000 icon. Bottom-aligned, add a kicker in Inter 400 at 15px in #777169, then a 4px gap, then a description in Inter 400 at 15px, line-height 1.467, in #000000.

4. Build a navigation bar. Make a static, transparent row inside a 1180px container, 36px tall, with justify-content space-between. On the left, place a black wordmark, then a 32px gap, then six links (Products, Solutions, Customers, Resources, Enterprise, Pricing) in Inter 400 at 14px, color #000000 and a 20px gap, with no underlines. On the right, place a 36px #ffffff pill "Log in" (radius 9999px, padding 0 14px, Inter 14px, the shadow sm ring) and a 36px #000000 pill "Sign up" with #ffffff text, separated by 8px. Above the nav, add a #f5f3f1 announcement strip with centered 14px copy and a 32px #ffffff Discover chip.

**Role:** Switches between three product families

Segmented control on a tray. The rail is #f5f3f1 with 16px 16px 0 0 corners and 6px padding at a measured 76px height. The active tab is #ffffff with a 10px radius (estimated) and shadow sm. Inactive tabs are transparent. Labels are Inter 16px at weight 400 in #000000, each led by an 8px product dot: #ff4704 or #0447ff, plus a neutral gray glyph. The dots are punctuation rather than decoration — the only chromatic UI in the hero.

### Showcase Card (Main Content Card)

**Role:** Hero canvas for interactive demos

Large rounded tray. It uses background #f5f3f1, a 16px radius, 0 32px padding and a 1180px width at 558px tall. There is no border, only shadow subtle (an inset 0.5px ring at 7.5% black). It holds the orb carousel, tool chips and an Ink Sign up pill. Content inside sits on #ffffff or directly on the tray. This is the system's largest container, and its tonal fill replaces a hero image — the product demo is the hero.

### Voice Orb Carousel

**Role:** Previews voice categories as playable spheres

Circular gradient artwork. Orbs render at measured diameters of 109px, 145px and 202px; these are artwork dimensions, not spacing tokens. Each orb is a 9999px-radius image, with the centered orb carrying a 44px #ffffff play disc and an #000000 glyph. The active caption is Inter 16px in #000000 with an arrow, and inactive titles drop to #777169. Descriptions sit at 13px in #a59f97. Chevrons flank the center. The orbs are the system's sanctioned color outlet, and the chrome around them stays achromatic.

### Tool Chip Row

**Role:** Filters the demo by capability

Inline pill selector. The active chip ("AI Voice Generator") uses #ffffff, a 9999px radius, 0 12px padding, a 36px height and shadow sm. Inactive chips are transparent text in #44403b at Inter 15px, weight 400, separated by a 12px gap. A trailing Ink pill sits flush right. The selection reuses the Paper-button recipe exactly, so "chosen" and "secondary action" share one visual grammar.

### Text-to-Speech Demo Panel

**Role:** Live speech generation preview

White editing card. It uses background #ffffff, a 12px radius (estimated) and shadow subtle-2, set inside a #f5f3f1 tile. The textarea is Inter 16px at weight 400 and line-height 1.5 with 16px 20px 0 padding. Bracketed audio tags such as [giggles] are inlined in #a59f97. The footer row carries a language selector and a voice selector, each with a small flag or orb glyph, plus a 32px Ink Play pill. It treats prose as the interface and is the most product-literal block on the page.

### Feature Tile

**Role:** Four-up capability summary

Tall linen card. It uses background #f5f3f1, a 16px radius, shadow subtle and 20px padding (estimated). A 32px #ffffff icon square sits top-left with an 8px radius, shadow subtle-2 and a 1.5px line glyph in #000000. A kicker in Inter 15px #777169 and a description in Inter 15px #000000 sit bottom-aligned. Bottom-anchored text leaves deliberate empty space above, so the tiles read as index cards rather than dense feature lists.

### Logo Wall

**Role:** Customer proof in a ruled grid

Hairline-ruled grid. The grid has six columns and three rows of grayscale logos on #fdfcfc, framed by 1px #ebe8e4 horizontal and vertical rules that continue the page's side rails. There are no tiles or fills. A heading in Inter 16px #000000 sits left, with a Paper pill ("Read all stories") right, 36px tall. Logos are tinted to the Pebble range, so the wall reads as a ledger of names, not a parade of brand colors.

### Product Screenshot Frame — Edge-to-Edge Outlier

**Role:** Shows dashboards inside the system

Tray holding UI. The frame is #f5f3f1 with 16px top corners and shadow subtle, holding two #ffffff application screenshots side by side, cropped at the bottom edge. Screenshots carry their own internal palette, including a status red #f41a2f and a link blue #0a59d2 that are mockup-internal, not system tokens. The bottom crop is the deliberate outlier: it is the only card without four rounded corners, and it implies the product continues past the page.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every section headline in Waldenburg at weight 300, 36px, with 1.167 line-height — the light display weight is the brand's voice, and the restraint is non-negotiable.
- Pair every #000000 Ink pill with a #ffffff Paper pill carrying shadow sm — the two-pill couplet is the system's only action grammar.
- Group content on #f5f3f1 trays with a 16px radius before reaching for borders — tonal layering keeps line count low.
- Rank text by tone: #000000 for primary, #777169 for labels, #a59f97 for tertiary — size steps of 14, 15 and 16px are too close to carry hierarchy alone.
- Keep Inter tracking at +0.01em (0.14px at 14px, 0.16px at 16px) — the looseness gives small UI text its printed calm.
- Separate sections with 160px of #fdfcfc — the generous gap is what makes a light-weight headline feel confident.
- Confine saturated color to orbs, screenshots and 8px product dots in #ff4704 or #0447ff — color is content here, not chrome.

### Don't

- Don't bump headlines to weight 500 or 600 to "add punch" — at 48px a heavier Waldenburg turns the whisper into a shout and breaks the quiet-authority thesis.
- Don't fill the primary CTA with #ff4704 — an orange button competes with the orbs and makes the brand look like every other AI tool.
- Don't replace the 0.5px ring with a 1px solid #e5e5e5 border on buttons — the doubled edge reads as a form field, not a pill.
- Don't use cool grays such as #6b7280 for secondary text — they clash with #f5f3f1 and drain the warm plaster feel; stay on #777169.
- Don't add drop shadows above 4% opacity or beyond 4px blur — the system lifts with tone and half-pixel rings, and heavy shadows float cards off the page.
- Don't round cards to 24px or square them to 4px — 16px cards against 9999px pills is the whole shape vocabulary, and a third value muddies it.
- Never apply a gradient to an interface surface such as a tray, nav or button — gradients belong to the orb artwork, and on chrome they erase the line between content and frame.

## Surfaces

| Level | Name | Value | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Paper Canvas | `#fdfcfc` | Page sheet, hero, logo wall and section backgrounds |
| 1 | Linen Panel | `#f5f3f1` | Trays: showcase card, tab rail, feature tiles, screenshot frames |
| 2 | Frosted Card | `#ffffff` | Selected or interactive items lifted out of trays: active tab, chips, TTS panel |
| 3 | Onyx Scrim | `#0000004d` | Translucent overlays on imagery and media controls |
| 4 | Jet Action | `#000000` | Inverted surface for primary pills and play glyphs |

## Elevation

- **Secondary pills, active tabs, chips (36 uses):** `0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.125), 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04), 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)`
- **Showcase card and feature tiles (21 uses):** `inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.075)`
- **Icon squares and inner white panels (13 uses):** `inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)`
- **Controls needing a firmer edge:** `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)`
- **Controls on colored imagery:** `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)`
- **Selected media strip (focus outline):** `inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)`

## Imagery

Imagery comes in three kinds: abstract gradient orbs, product screenshots and a single atmospheric gradient photograph behind the editor tile. There is no lifestyle photography in the hero. The orbs are 9999px-radius spheres in orange, violet, rust and pastel noise, and they are the page's entire saturated palette. They sit unframed on #f5f3f1 with no shadow. Screenshots sit inside #f5f3f1 trays with 16px corners, and they carry internal colors such as #f41a2f, #0a59d2 and #052f70 that are mockup-internal, not system tokens. Icons are 1.5px monoline glyphs in #000000 inside 32px #ffffff squares. Gradients are decorative only and never tokenized. The narrative is that the product makes voices visible, so the voices get the color and the interface stays silent.

## Layout

Content sits inside a 1180px column on a 1920px page sheet. Faint #ebe8e4 vertical rails mark the column edges from the logo wall downward. Sections are separated by 160px, with 96px for tighter pairs. The hero is a two-column split: a 48px Waldenburg headline and a pill couplet on the left, and a 16px Inter paragraph on the right. Below it the full-width showcase card holds the demo. Sections alternate between canvas-level text blocks (36px headline left, paragraph right) and linen-tray content. Grids run 6 columns for logos, 2 for the editor and TTS feature pair, and 4 for capability tiles. The nav is static, transparent and 36px tall, with the logo and six links left and Log in and Sign up right. The footer is a 12px-padded multi-column link block with a language selector. At 375px, set the display headline at 36px and the section gap at 64px. Density: spacious.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #fdfcfc (Paper Canvas)
- tray surface: #f5f3f1 (Linen Panel)
- lifted card: #ffffff (Frosted Card)
- primary text: #000000 (Ink)
- secondary text: #777169 (Pebble Caption)
- hairline: #ebe8e4 (Sand Hairline)
- primary action: #000000 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and graphs use #000000 lines and #777169 axes on #ffffff, with series fills as #0447ff tints at 10% opacity at most and #ff4704 limited to a single 8px marker. No data element may be more saturated or larger than an orb.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button. Make an anchor with background #000000, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 9999px, padding 0 20px and height 44px. Set it in Inter at 16px, weight 400 and line-height 1.5, with no shadow. On hover, drop the background opacity to 85%. Place it beside a secondary button with background #ffffff, text #000000, the same 9999px radius, 0 20px padding and 44px height, with box-shadow `0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.125), 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)` and an 8px gap between the two.

2. Build a hero section. Use a #fdfcfc page background and a 1180px max-width container with a two-column grid. In the left column, put an h1 in Waldenburg (fallback General Sans) at weight 300, 48px, line-height 1.083, letter-spacing -0.96px and color #000000, with two lines maximum. Follow it, 32px below, with the Ink and Paper pill couplet at 44px. In the right column, top-aligned, put a paragraph in Inter 400 at 16px, line-height 1.5, letter-spacing 0.16px and color #000000. Below, 48px down, add a full-width card with background #f5f3f1, radius 16px, padding 0 32px and box-shadow `inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.075)`.

3. Build a feature tile in a 4-column grid with a 12px gap. Give each tile background #f5f3f1, radius 16px, padding 20px, a 160px minimum height and box-shadow `inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.075)`. Top-left, place a 32px #ffffff square with radius 8px, box-shadow `inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)` and a 16px monoline #000000 icon. Bottom-aligned, add a kicker in Inter 400 at 15px in #777169, then a 4px gap, then a description in Inter 400 at 15px, line-height 1.467, in #000000.

4. Build a navigation bar. Make a static, transparent row inside a 1180px container, 36px tall, with justify-content space-between. On the left, place a black wordmark, then a 32px gap, then six links (Products, Solutions, Customers, Resources, Enterprise, Pricing) in Inter 400 at 14px, color #000000 and a 20px gap, with no underlines. On the right, place a 36px #ffffff pill "Log in" (radius 9999px, padding 0 14px, Inter 14px, the shadow sm ring) and a 36px #000000 pill "Sign up" with #ffffff text, separated by 8px. Above the nav, add a #f5f3f1 announcement strip with centered 14px copy and a 32px #ffffff Discover chip.

## Chromatic Quarantine

The discipline is that the interface owns no hue. Every tray, pill, label and rule is drawn from #000000 and warm grays (#44403b, #777169, #a59f97, #ebe8e4). Saturation is quarantined inside orbs, screenshots and two 8px dots in #ff4704 and #0447ff. The pattern breaks the moment a designer tints a tray blue, adds an orange hover state, or colors a feature icon to "add energy". Any chromatic chrome competes with the voices the orbs represent. To extend the system, let new products bring their own orb artwork and one identity dot, and keep all controls in Ink and Paper. If a new status signal is needed, render it as a dot under 12px, never as a filled surface.

## Light-Weight Authority

Waldenburg at weight 300 is the most anti-convention choice on the page. Category peers bold their headlines to 600 or 700. ElevenLabs sets 48px and 36px headlines light and lets 160px of empty #fdfcfc supply the emphasis. What breaks it: heavier weights, tighter section gaps under 96px, or centering headlines over busy imagery, all of which drain the calm the thin stroke depends on. To extend, add sizes only on the Perfect Fourth ladder (36px to 48px is 1.333). Keep negative tracking (-0.02em) for the 48px display tier only. Push emphasis into Inter 500 at 14px for UI labels rather than into the display face.

## Half-Pixel Edges

Edges in this system are 0.5px rings at 7.5% to 12.5% black, not borders. The rings sit on 16px cards and 9999px pills, and only the secondary pill adds a 4% drop at 2px 4px. That restraint keeps the page flat and paper-like while still separating #ffffff from #f5f3f1, a contrast of barely 3%. Swapping rings for 1px opaque borders, raising drop opacity above 4%, or stacking ring plus border on the same element all break it. To extend, give any new lifted element shadow sm and any new tray shadow subtle. Reserve the 1.5px solid black inset ring for genuine selection states only.

## Similar Brands

- **Vercel** — Shares black filled pill CTAs, Geist-family type and hairline-ruled grids. Vercel uses a cool neutral canvas where ElevenLabs warms every gray toward #f5f3f1.
- **OpenAI** — Shares light-weight display headlines over a near-white canvas, with color confined to gradient artwork. OpenAI's artwork is full-bleed, and ElevenLabs contains its color in 9999px spheres.
- **Anthropic** — Shares a warm off-white canvas and a warm-tinted secondary text tone. Anthropic leans on a serif display face, and ElevenLabs uses a light grotesk.
- **Runway** — A generative-media competitor that also keeps chrome monochrome so generated output carries the color. Runway runs dark, and ElevenLabs runs light.
- **Linear** — Shares 0.5px ring borders and near-invisible drop shadows as the main elevation mechanism. Linear applies them on dark surfaces with an indigo accent ElevenLabs refuses.
